questions.question: Is the inside of the safety trailer clean and organized?
Is the outside of the safety trailer clean and free of trash and clutter?
Is there at least one inspected, accessible fire extinguisher in the trailer?
Is the trailer marked with a sign, and is the right signage organized inside and out?
Is the orientation area clean and organized, with room for people to sit and see the screen?
Are stickers, wallet cards, T-shirts, and other handouts organized and stocked?
Is the Work Rules Acknowledgement QR code printed and ready to scan at the start of orientation?
Is there a backup device, like a spare phone, tablet, or computer, for the Work Rules Acknowledgement in WorkSafe?
Is the site-specific orientation deck up to date and in use?

follow_up.any: What's the last revision date of the deck?

questions.question: Is there good hands-on demo material, like knives, PPE, barricades, and tools, organized for orientation?
Does everyone get a wallet card at orientation, and do all foremen get a Safety and Health Code book at First Day, First Hour training?
Is the Incident Reporting Checklist posted where people can get to it?
Is the OSHA Inspection Checklist posted where people can get to it?
Is the Government Agency Inspection Checklist posted where people can get to it?
Is the project's Emergency Action Plan posted where people can get to it?

follow_up.Yes: What's the last revision date of the plan?

questions.question: Is the Emergency Contact Phone Number List posted where people can get to it?
Is the first aid kit fully stocked with nothing expired?
Is the nurse's area set up, stocked, and in good order?
Is the SDS binder available and current for every chemical on site?
Are recent Safety Alerts posted where workers can easily read them?
Are all crews doing good quality PTSAs each day, reviewed by the foreman and signed by the whole crew?
Is the Clayco project team addressing deficient PTSAs each morning?
Are all subcontractors turning in weekly safety audits?
Are all subcontractors turning in the toolbox talks they hold each week?
Are subs doing hot work, ground disturbance, or roof work completing Safe Work Permits?
Are crews inspecting their equipment before starting work?
Is all paperwork scanned and saved to the project's K drive folder, with no more than a week of backlog?
Is the subcontractor onboarding matrix up to date?
Are the five most recent subs to start on site on the onboarding matrix?

follow_up.any: Who are the last five subs?

questions.question: Is everyone on site marked green in the OK TO WORK column of the Insurance Log?
Are all subs and tiered subs on the Competent Person List, with current information?
Are all subs and tiered subs on the Safety Representative List, with current information?
Is at least one subcontractor working on site right now?

follow_up.any: About how many sub companies are on site, and how many people total, subs plus Clayco?

questions.question: Do any subs have 25 to 74 people on site, including tiered subs?
Does each of those subs have at least one full-time safety rep on site who meets the Safety and Health Code?
Do any subs have 75 to 149 people on site, including tiered subs?
Does each of those subs have at least two full-time safety reps on site who meet the Safety and Health Code?
Do any subs have 150 or more people on site, including tiered subs?
Does each of those subs have at least three full-time safety reps on site who meet the Safety and Health Code?
Are all sub workers doing Stretch and Flex each day?

follow_up.any: What time and where is Stretch and Flex?

questions.question: Are all Clayco employees doing Stretch and Flex each day?
Is at least one site-wide toolbox talk held each week?

follow_up.Yes: What time and where are the toolbox talks?

questions.question: Are toolbox talks given in English and Spanish when needed?
Can everyone see and hear during Stretch and Flex and toolbox talks, with enough lighting and a speaker system?
Does anything need to change to improve Stretch and Flex or toolbox talks?
